The Qur’an Examined

Language, meaning, and the case for revelation.

Expanded research draft 0.2: an opening essay and 6 chapters, approximately 14,600 words including notes. Four chapters are new in this edition. The full book and proposed studies remain in development; independent scholarly review is pending.

Chapter numbers follow the full book plan. The available chapters are arranged in their intended reading order.
